newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania c.bank reserves rise in February.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania c.bank reserves rise in February.

text.p: The Lithuanian central bank said on Friday that its official reserves rose in February to $795 million against $793.2 million in January.
The convertible currency reserves of the central bank advanced to $726.7 million from $723.6 million dollars, the central bank said in a statement.
The bank's gold reserves remained stable at $62 million and its SDR holdings dropped to $6.3 million dollars in February versus $7.6 million in January.
